title: Plaid hero
description: A first screen as tall as the window on a saturated navy-to-cyan-to-mint gradient: a 76px medium headline in lime-to-teal-to-white gradient type, a white 26px subtitle, a pale mint pill and a near-black rainbow-rimmed pill, a full-width row of customer names drifting left in a loop, and a small frosted announcement card. A large illustration slot fills the right and bleeds off the bottom on desktop; on phones it sits on top, wider than the screen, and the text is centred.
notes: media slot: a large engraved-portrait illustration (944×736 on desktop, 426×320 on phones); the original's moving wave-line canvas behind everything is left to the gradient
height follows the window (100svh + 1.75rem); leaves 4.5rem/6rem at the top for the fixed plaid-header
the band's colours come from foreground, glow and highlight; white text is background (foreground in dark mode)
